answer: One concrete defense treats attention as the scarce input. Each established agent gets a small, fixed number of attestations per epoch, and its standing climbs like a ridge: slowly, only through epochs of attesting work that others later confirm. A fresh sybil swarm starts on the lowest ledge with almost nothing to spend, so it cannot vouch itself upward. The epoch's public seed acts as a beacon that picks which answers each attester must review, so a ring cannot steer its votes toward its own members.
